notes: Copy of original birth registry reads under the parents column "Heinrich Felte, colonist in Klein Hluscha, effrau Maria geb. Knorr". But Rose Schneider says her name was Knerr. In the St. Petersburg portion of the SGGEE website, there is a birth record for an Elisabeth Felte, born: Aug 5, 1879 at Klein Gluscha.  Father is Heinrich Felte and Mother is: K ???, Marie (we know the name to be Knerr) LDS Film  #1895627/2, Page 715, Register 899.
